notes.title: 'As Long As You're Here' showcased at SXSW Sydney 2025! 🎇
notes.content:
[h2]We're so happy to announce that our game has been selected for the annual SXSW Sydney showcase on October 13-19![/h2][p][/p][p]It's always exciting to be selected, and to get a chance to see the public respond to our little baby. Working on a game for years in a vacuum can be hard, and you wonder if others will see what we see.  So this outside validation means a lot to us game developers! It also means we get to add these beautiful little laurels. 🥰
  [/p][p]We hope you'll like it, and if you don't live around Sydney yourself: do not worry. Our game will be coming out very soon after! 🙌[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more news as we finish up 'As Long As You're Here'. 
We can't wait to share it with you all when it's ready.[/p][p][/p][p]Love,
The Autoscopia team (Ryan, Marlène, Jordy, Roxanne) ❤️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45357454/04b95acb34be75f3206a21fd1a704ef52eb22dc0.png"][/img][/p]
